name: smwgraphics-enemy
title: Enemy 585 - Castle
description:
The castle BG from Nitrome's Enemy 585 flash game, this is my first ExAnimation, and I couldn't find any other way to record this than by using a potato and converting it into a GIF! I compressed the BG's palette to fit in the lava's palette, but I couldn't fit the King Frog statue, because I'm afraid that will occupy a lot of space in the FG3 GFX file.

Note: It requires a sprite status bar or a patch in order to make it work like the RAM Toggled Status Bar (& IRQ) Patch as a example.
